fato_historico: 1969: Mỹ Lai Massacre: U.S. Army Lieutenant William Calley is charged with six specifications of premeditated murder for the death of 109 Vietnamese civilians in My Lai.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace deep healing and gentle reflection. Just as the world learns to mend the scars of past shadows, you may find peace in your emotional sanctuary. It is a good time to release heavy burdens and focus on the quiet strength found in compassion, allowing your heart to bloom with hopeful and tender grace.
frase_do_dia: Healing begins when we choose to nurture love in the face of old shadows.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual growth and the pursuit of inner truth.
conselho: Consider extending grace to yourself while tending to your beautiful, emotional garden today.
